about_short_description.short_description: Brisk Teaching provides AI-powered tools for educators to enhance teaching with digital resources.

product.name: Brisk AI Education Platform
product.description: An AI platform for educators that creates instructional materials, adapts content, provides assignment feedback, and supports student learning within existing education tools.

product.name: Brisk Extension
product.description: A Chrome and Microsoft Edge extension that adds AI tools to commonly used education resources, documents, and webpages for content creation, feedback, writing analysis, and differentiated instruction.

product.name: Brisk Web Experience
product.description: A web workspace for creating and managing AI-generated instructional resources, reviewing class insights, giving batch feedback, and accessing recommendations and creation history.

product.name: Brisk Boost
product.description: A student-facing set of AI learning tools that turns online resources into interactive activities and provides features such as chat, visual whiteboards, and teacher-controlled support.

product.name: Brisk Next
product.description: An AI planning and recommendation feature that suggests instructional materials and student activities using class data, standards, grade level, and recent Brisk usage.

product.name: AI Tools for Educators
product.description: A collection of specialized generators and workflow tools for producing lessons, assessments, instructional resources, interventions, administrative communications, and personalized student feedback.
